results.summary: Customer is locked out of their account after three failed password reset attempts, as the reset email is never received, and needs access to complete time-sensitive work today.
Customer reports production dashboard has been unavailable since 9:05 AM, with multiple users receiving 503 errors and the operations team unable to monitor jobs.
Customer was charged twice for the same monthly subscription and is requesting a review and refund of the duplicate charge.
Customer requests a CSV export option for filtered results on the reports page, as their team currently copies data manually into spreadsheets.
Customer reports that loading the customer list takes ~40 seconds after the latest update, up from under 5 seconds, slowing down the team's daily work while the app remains usable.
A new employee is unable to access the team workspace and sees an "Access denied" message despite the sender verifying the invitation email address is correct.
Customer received a login alert from an unrecognized country and wants support to review whether any account data was accessed or changed.
Customer reports that since 10:40 all checkout attempts are failing due to HTTP 500 errors from the payment API, resulting in ongoing loss of sales.
Customer cancelled their subscription last week and is requesting a refund for the unused days remaining in the current billing month, with no time pressure indicated.
Customer's nightly import has failed two consecutive nights due to the /sync API endpoint timing out after 60+ seconds, leaving their team working with stale data daily with no available workaround.
Customer requests a dark mode option for the web app to reduce eye strain during late-night use, with no urgency indicated.
Customer requests a new feature to export dashboards as PDF files for use in monthly meetings.
Customer Lee Carter sent an email with no body content; the nature of their issue is unknown.
Customer reports two issues: an October invoice overcharge (25 seats billed vs. 20 actual), and a critical outage where no team member can open the app, seeing only a blank page since this morning.
Customer reports a typo on the settings page ("Recieve" instead of "Receive") — no functional impact, cosmetic issue only.
Customer reports that something is not working, but provides no further details about the issue.
Customer cannot log in because they lost their phone and are unable to receive MFA codes, with a client demo in two hours requiring urgent access restoration.
Customer requests update of their VAT number (GB123456789) on future invoices, as the current one on record is outdated.
Customer requests a Google Calendar integration to sync app deadlines, explicitly noting it is not urgent.
Customer reports that monthly report generation has degraded from ~1 minute to ~15 minutes, while smaller reports remain unaffected.
All 300 staff are unable to upload files since 8:00 AM due to a 'Storage unavailable' error, blocking document attachments to records organisation-wide.
